notes: Dated exceptions to the pull-request visual-drift check. A waiver is for a web change that provably does not alter what the surface shows (for example a refactor with no layout or copy change), never for a redesign. It names the surface, why, the issue that carries the decision and the date after which it no longer applies. `npm run check:visual-drift` fails on a malformed or expired waiver.

waivers.reason: Neither web change alters a recorded box, colour or word: the keyboard focus ring on the notes row overlay is unfocused in the recorded at-rest and open-note states (issue #1696), and the relative stamps move from the formatter's sentence to the surface's generated copy with byte-identical Arabic, the same thresholds and the same Hijri fallback (issue #1747). The contract measures boxes, font and radius, so neither the recorded values nor the captures can change.

The web change is a copy refactor: literals and the contract table's kind and action labels move into one generated copy module with byte-identical rendered values, and the torch label plus the OTP-secret and contact rows are app-side changes that bring the native screen up to the page. No page layout, colour or user-facing word changed, so neither the recorded boxes nor the captures can move. #1707 pairs the two clients and records the visual re-record of the native icons.

The web band's data-visual tag moved to a generated constant with the same rendered value, and its copy source was added for that constant; no layout, colour or user-facing word changed. The profile evidence re-record is carried by #1631.

The only web change is a state refactor: the QR dialog's SVG, failure flag and retry key move from three `useState` calls into one reducer beside the component. The rendered markup, classes, copy and every state value are identical, so neither the recorded contract numbers nor the captures can move.

The counter stays the same <button> with the same classes, text and copy: native `disabled` was replaced by `aria-disabled` plus a guarded handler so focus survives completion. No layout, colour or user-facing word changed, and the recorded at-rest states are unfocused, so neither the contract numbers nor the captures can move. The keyboard behaviour is asserted in #1670.

The budget card's state moved into a pure reducer beside it (#1100): the month load and the save now settle in one transition, but the same props, markup, class names, copy and data-* attributes render. No box, colour, font or word the capture records can move, so the existing evidence stays correct and a re-record would only reproduce it.

The only web change is a detail-row icon's hover/focus fill, from the light primary to the darker filled-control pair (#1669). The recorded at-rest state is unfocused, and its contract measures boxes rather than colour, so neither the recorded numbers nor the card raster can change.

The only web change is the fill of the signed-in reconnect button (#1669). The contract records one at-rest guest screen and explicitly excludes the signed-in states, so no recorded box or pixel contains the changed control.

The only web change is the fill of the latest-digest link shown when the archive has no digest for the requested date (#1669). Both recorded states render a seeded digest or the unavailable block, so no recorded box or pixel contains the changed control.

The only change in the gated web file is a null-rendering component that marks the server-rendered sura's content for the paint gate. The tafsir control itself keeps the same class, box and word: a link before hydration and the same-sized button after it. The Mushaf face is still loaded in the visual capture, which waits for document.fonts.ready on an unthrottled link; the optional display only keeps the fallback on a first visit slow enough to miss the block period, a state the capture does not record. No box, pixel, font or word the contract measures can move.

The web change is confined to the failed-read face and to handing a failed loader read (null) to the surface's own client read. The gate records only the `at-rest` state with a live board: the title, freshness line and converters keep the same boxes, copy and classes, and the new retry control sits on the failure branch the capture never draws. No recorded box or pixel can move; #1743 covers the failure face in its own Playwright spec.

The web change adds a screen-reader-only press label and the icon for the `post_published` type (#1752), and now paints the relative-time line with the opaque --metadata token instead of an alpha composed onto muted-foreground (#1833). The recorded Alerts states seed existing types, so no recorded row draws the new label or glyph; the time keeps its 11px and the contract records boxes, font and radius but not colour, so no recorded number or visible word moves. The type's press and destination are asserted in the notification-target and notifications-view tests.

The web change is a state refactor: the member list, its load failure, the action error and the row being lifted move from five `useState` calls into one reducer beside the component (#1102). Every JSX expression, class name, copy string and rendered state value is identical, so neither the recorded contract numbers nor the captures can move.

The web change is a state refactor: the connected-app list, the failed/offline flags, the action error, the disconnect target and the busy flag move from six `useState` calls into one reducer beside the component (#1102). Every JSX expression, class name, copy string and rendered state value is identical, so neither the recorded contract numbers nor the captures can move.

The web change is a state refactor in both panels: the preferences' sources/selection/loading/load-error/saving and the private sources' summary/loading/load-error/removing/busy fields move from `useState` calls into one reducer per panel (#1102). Every JSX expression, class name, copy string and rendered state value is identical, so neither the recorded contract numbers nor the captures can move.

The web change adds a remove control for the post's author and a report selector for other signed-in members to comment rows, and passes the post's author id into the thread; it only adds copy keys. The recorded at-rest state is a public post with no signed-in comments, and the contract measures only the post column, author chip, cover, tags and body, so no recorded box, colour or word moves. #1799 and #1800 carry the controls and their interaction tests.

The contract records only the guest at-rest state - the title and guest card. The change gives the signed-in member's empty history a key chosen from the plan in force; shared/visual/account-plan.json explicitly excludes the member's Ready state and the capture never draws it. No recorded box, colour, word or raster can move, and #1806 carries component tests for all three new sentences.
